name: claudeswap
description: See your active Claude Code account in the status bar and switch between accounts (personal, company) and saved API keys in one click.
author: LogicalAngel (https://technello.com)

commands.title: Claude: Forget Saved Account or API Key
Claude: Pin an Account or API Key to This Workspace
Claude: Unpin Account from This Workspace
Claude: Show Account in Claude Code Status Line
Claude: Rename Saved Account or API Key

claudeAccounts.statusBar.show.description: Show the active Claude account in the status bar.

claudeAccounts.account.description: Email, name or account id of the Claude account, or name of the saved API key, this workspace should use. Claude then runs with it in this window only (the Claude Code panel and the terminals); if it cannot be set up, Claude stays signed out here instead of using another account. Set this in workspace settings (.vscode/settings.json), usually via the 'Pin an Account or API Key to This Workspace' command.

claudeAccounts.accountColors.markdownDescription: Status bar text colour per account or API key, keyed by email, alias or key name. Values are CSS colours or theme colour ids, for example `{ "you@company.com": "#4FC1FF" }`.

scripts.check:sync: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(f.readFileSync('lib/credentials.js','utf8')!==f.readFileSync('claude-plugin/lib/credentials.js','utf8')){console.error('claude-plugin/lib/credentials.js is out of date; run npm run sync:plugin');process.exit(1)}"
